exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Creatinine ≤institutional ULN or GFR of ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m2
ECOG performance status of 2 or greater.
Has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) (HIV 1/2 antibodies).
Known to be diagnosed and/or treated for any other additional malignancy within 2 years prior to registration with the exception of the following
total serum bilirubin ≤1.5X upper limit of normal (ULN) (except for subjects with documented Gilbert syndrome) and AST (SGOT) and ALT (SGPT) ≤2.5X ULN
